docFill.description: Upload a contract or any document and DocFill detects the data that repeats (names, ID numbers, amounts, dates, blanks). You type each value once and it's replaced throughout the document, including tables and amounts written in words. Works with Word, PDF (with OCR for scans), Excel and more, with no AI and no server: everything is processed locally. Available as an installable web app (PWA) and an Electron desktop app.
